scope: REST API settings screen (1.3.1, shipped in 1.4.0)

hypothesis.claim: Binding the status to a server event, reporting export results next to the button and masking the key removes every defect the owner saw, without changing the API itself
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: Status stale after start, export result invisible, key written by APPLY, or a dialog opening without an application

decision.why: The server knows when it starts or fails; polling adds lag and work

change.summary: IRestApiServer.StateChanged; UpdateApiServerStatusText; Save-dialog export to Documents with ApiExportStatus and OPEN FOLDER; APPLY writes no key; DELETE removes legacy file; masked key with SHOW/COPY; headless dialog guard
change.scope_authority: Owner 2026-10-17 report (screenshot); 'For REST API, go with these recommendations'

positive: ApiSettingsScreenTests: RUNNING shown on server event; export result shown

what_worked: Dialog hook made the screen testable headless
what_failed: Old tests opened a real SaveFileDialog and hung the test host
residual_risk: Live re-check on the installed 1.4.0 pending (T22-WP3)

reuse.reuse_applied: tools/api_smoke.py from 1.3 for the live check

lessons.transferable_rule: Bind UI state to service events; show results next to the action

next_action.action: Owner installs 1.4.0, regenerates the API key; live api_smoke check/watch

hypothesis.claim: Same-radio TSF agreement, WPS UUID and MAC-family rules group the owner's BSSIDs into physical units correctly, and unit selection/tests/reports can be added without changing any existing behaviour
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: The owner's router does not form one unit, unrelated OUIs merge, a coincident clock persists as a link, or any existing test/parity row fails

decision.why: Works for any equipment without credentials or measurement-boundary change; owner: 'a unit approximation ... would be a strong MVP'
rejected: D first (disconnects the PC; DR-0004 boundary)
